guarantees.claim: unused_prd_masking[WidthPRDMasking-1 -: WidthPRDKey] is continuously driven by prd_key_expand.
guarantees.cond: always when this code is active

guarantees.claim: An immediate assertion fires if prd_masking != unused_prd_masking.
guarantees.cond: always when this code is active and assertion enabled

assumptions.claim: WidthPRDMasking >= WidthPRDKey, otherwise the partial select is out-of-bounds.
assumptions.risk: Invalid partial select leads to undefined width, possible x-propagation, or synthesis failure.

uncertain_points.claim: Only the top slice of unused_prd_masking is assigned here; the remaining bits must be driven by other logic to satisfy the assertion prd_masking == unused_prd_masking.
uncertain_points.risk: If other chunks do not correctly drive the unused bits, the masking PRD will be incomplete or the assertion will fire, potentially breaking masking.

uncertain_points.claim: If WidthPRDMasking and WidthPRDKey are not sized appropriately, the partial select may not cover the intended PRD region, making the assertion useless or always failing.
uncertain_points.cond: if parameter values are mismatched with the expected PRD structure
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect widths could silently weaken masking by leaving bits undriven or mismatched.

uncertain_points.claim: The exact purpose and coverage of assertion AesMskgPrdExtraction is undocumented; it is unclear whether it guarantees perfect extraction or only a partial sanity check.
uncertain_points.risk: If the assertion is too weak, PRD corruption may go undetected.
